name: iraqdata
title: Iraq Macroeconomic Data Package
description: Open, documented, and reproducible macroeconomic data package for Iraq. Covers monetary aggregates, official and parallel exchange rates, crude oil production and prices, consumer price inflation, public finances, balance of payments, merchandise trade, quarterly national accounts (GDP), and external cross-border banking. Compiled and derived data are licensed CC-BY-4.0; source data remain subject to each publisher's terms, listed under `sources`.

series.name_ar: الرقم القياسي العام لأسعار المستهلك (سلسلة مترابطة، 2022 = 100)
series.description: Continuous monthly headline consumer price index linked by iraqdata from the 1993, 2007, 2012 and 2022 native base series (not a series published by COSIT or the CBI). Each older base is used through December of its overlap year and the series switches base the following January, linking at that December (a December one-month overlap); every switch month carries status flag B. On the 2022 base's scale without rescaling, so "2022 = 100" is approximate (the linked 2022 average is not exactly 100). Factors, splice months and the remaining year-on-year gaps are in docs/linked_inflation_method.md.

origin.method: Linked from the four published CPI bases (1993, 2007, 2012, 2022 = 100) by a December one-month overlap, switching base each January after an overlap year (flag B); see docs/linked_inflation_method.md
origin.source: Central Bank of Iraq & COSIT

series.description: Continuous monthly core consumer price index linked by iraqdata from the 1993, 2007, 2012 and 2022 native core series (not a series published by COSIT or the CBI), by the same December one-month overlap as cpi_headline, with status flag B on every switch month. The core definition changes at the 1993 to 2007 switch - the 1993 base excludes fuel and lighting and transport and communications, the later bases exclude fruit and vegetables and kerosene and LPG - so values before and after it measure different core baskets. "2022 = 100" is approximate; details in docs/linked_inflation_method.md.

origin.method: Linked from the four published CPI bases (1993, 2007, 2012, 2022 = 100) by a December one-month overlap, switching base each January after an overlap year (flag B); see docs/linked_inflation_method.md

series.description: Headline real Gross Domestic Product in constant 2007 basic prices. Typed in from COSIT national accounts; values from 2020-Q1 that cite an archived document (most of them) are read back from it and are flagged A, or P for the latest eight quarters, which COSIT revises; values for quarters whose document is not archived carry status flag U. GDP is the line COSIT calls GDP, after the imputed bank service charge.

series.name_en: Real Non-Oil GDP at Constant Basic Prices (2007 = 100)
series.name_ar: الناتج المحلي الإجمالي عدا النفط بالأسعار الثابتة (أساس 2007 = 100)
series.description: Real gross value added of all non-oil activities in constant 2007 basic prices, computed as gdp.real minus gdp.real_oil; its status flag is the strongest of the two.

origin.method: Computed as gdp.real minus gdp.real_oil
origin.source: COSIT (via the transcribed totals)

series.name_en: Real Crude Oil GDP at Constant Basic Prices (2007 = 100)
series.name_ar: ناتج نشاط النفط الخام بالأسعار الثابتة (أساس 2007 = 100)
series.description: Real gross value added of crude petroleum extraction in constant 2007 basic prices. Typed in from COSIT national accounts; values from 2020-Q1 that cite an archived document (most of them) are read back from it and are flagged A, or P for the latest eight quarters, which COSIT revises; values for quarters whose document is not archived carry status flag U. From 2022 the early-warning reports print non-oil GDP, so oil is the total minus it.

series.name_en: Total Claims of BIS Reporting Banks on Iraq
series.name_ar: إجمالي مطالبات المصارف الدولية على العراق
series.description: Total cross-border claims (loans, debt securities, deposits, and other credit assets) of all BIS reporting banks on Iraqi counterparties across all sectors. Quarters in which the BIS marks a break in the series (its observation status B) carry status flag B; the BIS publishes a comparable pre-break value for them, which is not included here.

origin.method: Read from the archived source file named in source_file
origin.source: Bank for International Settlements (BIS)

series.name_en: Total Liabilities of BIS Reporting Banks to Iraq
series.name_ar: إجمالي التزامات المصارف الدولية تجاه العراق (ودائع وأصول العراق في الخارج)
series.description: Total liabilities of BIS reporting banks to Iraqi entities, representing deposits, custody holdings, and funds placed by Iraqi institutions and residents in global banking hubs. Quarters in which the BIS marks a break in the series (its observation status B) carry status flag B; the BIS publishes a comparable pre-break value for them, which is not included here.

origin.method: Read from the archived source file named in source_file
origin.source: Bank for International Settlements (BIS)

series.name_en: BIS Reporting Bank Liabilities to Iraqi Banks
series.name_ar: التزامات المصارف الدولية تجاه القطاع المصرفي العراقي
series.description: Liabilities of international reporting banks to the Iraqi banking system (Central Bank of Iraq and Iraqi commercial and state-owned banks). Quarters in which the BIS marks a break in the series (its observation status B) carry status flag B; the BIS publishes a comparable pre-break value for them, which is not included here.

origin.method: Read from the archived source file named in source_file
origin.source: Bank for International Settlements (BIS)

series.name_en: BIS Reporting Bank Liabilities to Non-Bank Sector
series.name_ar: التزامات المصارف الدولية تجاه القطاع غير المصرفي العراقي
series.description: Liabilities of international reporting banks to Iraqi non-bank counterparties, including government entities, public enterprises, and private residents. Quarters in which the BIS marks a break in the series (its observation status B) carry status flag B; the BIS publishes a comparable pre-break value for them, which is not included here.

origin.method: Read from the archived source file named in source_file
origin.source: Bank for International Settlements (BIS)

series.name_en: BIS Reporting Bank Claims on Non-Bank Sector
series.name_ar: مطالبات المصارف الدولية على القطاع غير المصرفي العراقي
series.description: Cross-border loans and credit extended by international reporting banks directly to Iraqi non-bank entities (general government, state enterprises, private sector). Quarters in which the BIS marks a break in the series (its observation status B) carry status flag B; the BIS publishes a comparable pre-break value for them, which is not included here.

origin.method: Read from the archived source file named in source_file
origin.source: Bank for International Settlements (BIS)

series.name_en: Iraq's Net Position vis-à-vis BIS Reporting Banks (Liabilities minus Claims)
series.name_ar: صافي مركز العراق تجاه المصارف المبلِّغة لبنك التسويات الدولية (الالتزامات ناقص المطالبات)
series.description: Liabilities of BIS reporting banks to Iraqi residents minus their claims on Iraqi residents, measured from the reporting banks' books (cross-border positions, all reporting countries, all sectors and instruments). It is Iraq's position against those banks; a positive value means Iraqi residents hold more with BIS reporting banks (deposits and other claims) than they owe them, so Iraq is a net creditor of the reporting banks. It covers banks only and is not the international investment position or Iraq's total net external assets. Quarters where either input is a BIS break carry status flag B.

origin.method: Computed as liabilities_total minus claims_total
origin.source: Bank for International Settlements (BIS)

series.name_en: Net ODA and Official Aid Received
series.name_ar: صافي المساعدات الإنمائية الرسمية والمعونات الرسمية المتلقاة
series.source: World Bank WDI (compiled from OECD DAC data)
series.description: World Bank indicator DT.ODA.ALLD.CD, "Net official development assistance and official aid received (current US$)", compiled by the World Bank from OECD DAC data. Net disbursements (gross disbursements minus principal repayments) of ODA and official aid to Iraq, converted from US dollars to millions.

origin.method: Read from the archived source file named in source_file
origin.source: World Bank WDI (compiled from OECD DAC data)

series.name_en: ODA Grants Received, Excluding Technical Cooperation
series.name_ar: المنح الإنمائية الرسمية المتلقاة باستثناء التعاون الفني
series.description: World Bank indicator BX.GRT.EXTA.CD.WD, "Grants, excluding technical cooperation (BoP, current US$)", which WDI sources from OECD DAC table DAC2A. Grants received by Iraq excluding technical cooperation, so it is not total ODA grants. Converted from US dollars to millions.

origin.method: Read from the archived source file named in source_file
origin.source: World Bank WDI (OECD DAC, DAC2A)
